scope: Post-hoc six-point projection diagnostic, not actual TSDF contribution provenance or physical free-space evidence
sampling: row-major component/rectangle indices floor(q*(n-1)), q=.25,.5,.75; nearest integer pixel floor(coord+.5); no interpolation
coordinates: original OpenGL C2W; same integer pixel/no half offset as evaluator; inverse training pose projects world point
residualSign: positive=recorded surface farther than test point, negative=recorded surface nearer (potential occlusion); uncertainty unmeasured
threshold: 20cm is existing fusion sdf_trunc; axial compatibility count only, not exact Euclidean TSDF weighting/contribution
